title: Evaluating a stage section in a pair-neighbourhood cocone
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $J$ an ideal, and $\mathcal C$ the full category under $B$ of etale maps [def-weil-etale-morphism] inducing bijections on quotients by $J$. Let $c$ be any cocone of its inclusion [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with vertex $B\to H$, and suppose $B/J\to H/JH$ is bijective. For an object $i=(B\to C)$, an etale $C$-algebra $D$ and a $C$-algebra map $s:D\to H/JH$ via the cocone map $C\to H$, there is a $C$-algebra map $t:D\to H$ reducing to $s$. Neither filteredness, essential smallness nor colimit universality is assumed.

proof.text: Use the inverse of the quotient bijection B/J to H/JH to turn the given section on D into a ring map s0:D to B/J. B-linearity follows from C-linearity and the under-category structure equation. Apply etale_section_neighbourhood_refinement to obtain N,j,k,r with k g=j, r fixing B and r k=s0.

Compose k with the cocone map p:N to H to obtain t. Cocone naturality for j shows that t fixes C. To compare reductions, any two B-linear ring maps from N to H/JH killing JN are equal: factor each through N/JN, precompose with the surjective quotient map B/J to N/JN, then use surjectivity B to B/J to check equality on B. Apply this to the reduced p and the composition of r with B/J to H/JH. They both fix B and kill JN. Restrict to D and use r k=s0 and the quotient equivalence inverse identity to conclude that t reduces to the given s.

theorem pair_henselization_stage_sections (B : Type u) [CommRing B] (J : Ideal B)
    (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of B) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom
            (Ideal.le_comap_map)))))
    (hq : Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.hom.hom
      Ideal.le_comap_map))
    (i : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun C : Under (CommRingCat.of B) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map C.hom) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (J.map C.hom.hom) C.hom.hom
            Ideal.le_comap_map)))
    (D : Type u) [CommRing D] (g : i.obj.right →+* D)
    (hd : letI : Algebra i.obj.right D := g.toAlgebra
      Algebra.Etale i.obj.right D)
    (s : letI : Algebra i.obj.right c.pt.right := (c.ι.app i).right.hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra i.obj.right D := g.toAlgebra
      D →ₐ[i.obj.right] c.pt.right ⧸ J.map c.pt.hom.hom) :
    letI : Algebra i.obj.right c.pt.right := (c.ι.app i).right.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra i.obj.right D := g.toAlgebra
    ∃ t : D →ₐ[i.obj.right] c.pt.right,
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ c.pt.right (J.map c.pt.hom.hom)).restrictScalars
        i.obj.right).comp t = s
